contact.conversation.p_text_2: A new design, website support, or a conversation about SEO and PPC. Tell us where you want to begin.
contact.conversation.img_alt_1: Two original sculptural speech bubbles represent a conversation.
contact.starting-points.p_text_2: A new website, a redesign or a WordPress development idea.
contact.starting-points.p_text_3: Changes, maintenance and website security upkeep.
contact.starting-points.p_text_4: A conversation about search engines and paid advertising.

home.agency.p_text_1: Cyberize Group / Digital solutions for small business
home.agency.p_text_2: One agency for the website you build, the care it needs, and the people you want to reach.
home.agency.img_alt_1: Three equal-sized sculptural panels—design and development, support and maintenance, and website traffic through SEO and PPC—joined by one flowing orange path.
home.solutions.p_text_1: Three starting points. One connected offer.
home.solutions.p_text_2: Cyberize Group is a B2B digital marketing agency. Start with the part your business needs, with design, website support and traffic in the same conversation.
home.solutions.p_text_3: From an idea or an existing site to a new design. Mockups, graphic design and WordPress development bring the website together.
home.solutions.p_text_4: Content changes, new pages and posts, menus, maintenance and site security. A practical home for your website to-do list.
home.solutions.p_text_5: SEO and paid advertising connect the website with the search engines and online channels people use.
home.traffic.p_text_2: Your website is one part of your digital presence. Search and advertising bring another set of questions: where people look, what they need and where an ad takes them.
home.traffic.img_alt_1: An organic-search field and a paid-search message show different routes to a relevant website.
home.traffic.p_text_4: Technical audits, on-page optimization and a four-step traffic process for local businesses.
home.traffic.p_text_6: Campaign planning, landing pages, tracking and ongoing review, considered together.
home.home-section-4.p_text_2: Tell us where you are now—and which part of your digital presence needs attention.

ppc.ppc-section-1.p_text_2: The campaign. The landing page. The next conversation. PPC for small businesses, considered from end to end.
ppc.ppc-section-1.img_alt_1: An oversized cursor and a landing page are connected by a winding orange path.
ppc.ppc-section-2.p_text_2: Pay-per-click advertising means paying when someone clicks your ad. The work around that click includes understanding the search, shaping the message and creating a relevant destination.
ppc.ppc-section-2.p_text_3: Our PPC approach connects campaign planning with web design, tracking and ongoing review. So the conversation doesn't stop when an ad goes live.
ppc.planning.p_text_4: We begin with a conversation about your business and the information needed to plan your campaigns.
ppc.planning.p_text_5: Keyword research, ad copy, landing pages and tracking come together in that plan. You review and approve the campaign before launch.
ppc.planning.br_text_2: The plan is yours to review before it goes live.
ppc.planning.img_alt_1: Campaign notes identify the business, audience, keywords and message beside a landing-page plan and an approval check.
ppc.ppc-section-4.p_text_3: Once you've approved the campaign, we launch it and begin monitoring how it relates to your business, customers and goals.
ppc.ppc-section-4.p_text_4: Campaign communication continues after launch, with reviews and updates as the work develops.
ppc.ppc-section-5.p_text_2: Six capabilities that support the campaign, from the account to the ongoing adjustments.
ppc.ppc-section-5.p_text_4: A destination connected to the ad's message.
ppc.ppc-section-5.p_text_5: A way to understand actions after the click.
ppc.ppc-section-5.p_text_6: Phone enquiries as part of the campaign picture.
ppc.ppc-section-6.p_text_2: The right conversation starts with your business and the campaign format. Our approach considers search, display and phone-led advertising.
ppc.ppc-section-6.p_text_3: Text-led advertising alongside a relevant search.
ppc.ppc-section-6.p_text_4: Visual advertising placed within online content.
ppc.ppc-section-6.p_text_5: A campaign format focused on phone contact.
ppc.ppc-section-7.p_text_4: After launch, campaign monitoring, ongoing optimizations and reporting keep the work moving.
ppc.ppc-section-7.p_text_5: Reviews and updates give you a way to discuss what's happening and what to consider next.

seo.search.p_text_2: Understand the channels, shape the content, and give people a way to find your business.
seo.search.img_alt_1: A flowing search-channel path links a question with relevant content,
seo.context.p_text_2: Search engine traffic and paid traffic are different channels. Our SEO work starts by understanding your business and where people in your niche look for information.
seo.context.p_text_3: Before adding a channel, consider the offer, the website and how the business will handle enquiries. Technical audits and on-page optimization are part of our SEO services.
seo.process.p_text_2: Find the channels that matter in your niche and understand where attention already flows.
seo.process.p_text_3: Look at the needs of the platforms and participants before deciding how to take part.
seo.process.p_text_4: Build a core message, then consider written content, video, audio or a combination. Reuse that message across suitable formats.
seo.process.h3_text_4: Give people a reason to share
seo.process.p_text_5: Traffic triggers are ways to encourage people to share your content. Consider sharing as part of the content plan, not an afterthought.
seo.content.p_text_1: A message with more than one form
seo.content.p_text_2: A useful core message can take different forms. We guide the content-creation conversation around written, video and audio material and the channels it is intended for.
seo.content.img_alt_1: One core message connects with written content, video, audio and ways to share.
seo.seo-section-5.p_text_2: Bring your business, your website and the questions people ask about what you do.

web-design.design.p_text_1: Website design / New or existing websites
web-design.design.p_text_2: Thoughtful visuals. Useful content. A website shaped around what your business wants to say.
web-design.design.img_alt_1: An original illustrative website and mobile layout linked by an orange ribbon.
web-design.blueprint.img_alt_1: A wireframe blueprint beside an illustrative finished website shows design moving toward development.
web-design.blueprint.p_text_1: From a blank page to a direction
web-design.blueprint.p_text_2: A new website or a redesign starts with your idea. Mockups and wireframes give that idea a visible structure before development brings it to life.
web-design.blueprint.p_text_3: Graphic design, content and WordPress development are part of the conversation—not separate afterthoughts.
web-design.brief.p_text_1: A design brief has moving parts
web-design.brief.p_text_2: Bring the images and ideas you want to work with. Design brings the color, imagery and page composition into one direction.
web-design.brief.p_text_3: What the website says matters alongside how it looks. A content-gathering conversation gives the pages something useful to communicate.
web-design.brief.p_text_4: New websites and redesigns begin from different places. We consider the pages, the content and how they fit together.
web-design.questions.p_text_2: Every website starts with a conversation. Here are some of the practical things to consider.
web-design.questions.summary_text_1: What if I don’t have a website?
web-design.questions.p_text_3: We can build a brand-new website or redesign an existing one. The starting point is different; the conversation still begins with your business and what the site needs to communicate.
web-design.questions.summary_text_2: Do you work with businesses outside the United States?
web-design.questions.p_text_4: Yes. We work with businesses internationally, with someone who can communicate with us in spoken and written English.
web-design.questions.p_text_5: We can discuss hosting options and your existing provider, including website moves and DNS changes where they form part of the agreed service.
web-design.questions.p_text_6: The level of customization affects the cost. Talk to us about your business and the website you have in mind so we can discuss a custom quote.
web-design.questions.p_text_7: Bring any specific images you want included during content gathering. We can discuss custom artwork and appropriately licensed sourced imagery as part of the website’s visual direction.
web-design.web-design-section-5.p_text_2: Tell us whether you are starting from nothing or rethinking the website you already have.

web-development.development.p_text_2: Custom websites and web applications built with WordPress as the core platform. Tell us what you have in mind—in your own words.
web-development.development.img_alt_1: An illustrative code panel connects content and function to a designed web page.
web-development.translation.p_text_1: Ideas do not arrive as code
web-development.translation.br_text_1: to talk in ones and zeros.
web-development.translation.p_text_2: WordPress is the foundation for our custom website and software-application work. The conversation starts with what your business wants to do, not with a list of technical terms.
web-development.translation.p_text_3: Design and development work together to turn the idea into website structure and functionality. If you have a design direction already, bring it into the conversation.
web-development.principles.p_text_2: Our development approach considers code quality, documentation and how the website is used.
web-development.principles.p_text_3: Structure that can be understood and worked with.
web-development.principles.p_text_4: Page loading as part of the development conversation.
web-development.principles.p_text_5: Consider the website across different screen sizes.
web-development.principles.p_text_6: How site structure relates to search and content.
web-development.principles.p_text_7: Technical upkeep as a continuing consideration.
web-development.documentation.p_text_3: We write and document code so the original developer—or someone new to the project—can understand it.
web-development.documentation.p_text_4: Third-party integrations can be part of your website conversation. We discuss the tools your business needs rather than assuming a standard stack fits every project.
web-development.web-development-section-5.p_text_2: Bring the functionality you have in mind. We can take the technical conversation from there.

website-support.support.p_text_4: New content. A menu change. A page that needs attention. Bring the everyday website work into one conversation.
website-support.changes.p_text_2: Adding a new page or post, or changing content that is already there.
website-support.changes.p_text_3: Updating a menu as website content changes.
website-support.changes.p_text_4: Visual changes and content updates for an existing website.
website-support.upkeep.img_alt_1: A website change list with pages, menus and color updates sits beside a shield representing maintenance and security upkeep.
website-support.upkeep.p_text_2: Website support includes maintenance and attention to site security, alongside the content and visual changes people can see.
website-support.upkeep.p_text_3: Talk to us about your existing website and the support it needs. The starting point is your site and the changes you have in mind.
website-support.website-support-section-4.p_text_2: Tell us which website changes and maintenance questions are on your mind.
